# relcore

The True Revenue Partner relationship layer. Standard library only.

Every person, partner organization and revenue partnership gets a living card in the Obsidian vault. A context
graph links them to each other, to their partner type's dossier note, to the TRP employee who owns them and to
hubs (tiers, niches, promo channels, sources, offers, campaigns, regions, stages). relcore is the only writer of
those cards; owner edits made in Obsidian are read back.

See `docs/RELATIONSHIP-LAYER.md` for the full design.
